title:
Used to handle user navigating away from sensor mapping.
The epic handles following things:
1. Force redirect to sensor mapping page: On 'Reliability.SensorMappingPageTitle.ACTIVE_TAB_SET', the epic
     - Starts listening to any GLOBAL_REDIRECT's happening and force redirects user back to sensor mapping page via a {@link NavigationHelper#handleForceBackRedirect}.
     - The epic also stores the page user originally intended to navigate to in application state and opens a warning modal.
     - Stops helper from listening, when GLOBAL_REDIRECT is fired with payload having 'exitAnyway' parameter set to true.

2. Exit anyway from sensor mapping page: On 'GLOBAL_REDIRECT' with 'exitAnyway' set to true, the epic
     Fires 'GLOBAL_REDIRECT' to page user originally intended to navigate to and clear relevant application and component state.
name: ExitSensorMappingEpic
